brief: The canvas displays an interactive stovetop surface featuring several circular burners and a central control dial. The primary interaction involves rotating the dial, allowing the user to control the gas flow. As the dial is turned, vivid blue natural gas flames will appear and shift across the circular burners. The flames must react dynamically and realistically to the user's input, creating a visually functional stovetop that cycles through different states based on the dial's position.
prompt: an interactive stovetop. turn the dial and blue natural gas flames appear on the circular burners.
statement: This sketch creates an interactive stovetop interface where users can rotate a central control dial to adjust gas flow across four circular burners. As the dial is turned, dynamic blue and yellow flames appear and shift around the burners, responding to the dial's position in real-time. The visualization includes a realistic stovetop surface with burners and a control dial that visually reacts to user input through mouse dragging, while also automatically cycling through states when idle to demonstrate continuous motion.
